description:
Fetch multiple products at once by their UUIDs (max 100 per
    call). Useful when an agent already has a list of candidate
    product IDs (e.g. from a previous search) and wants full current
    data for all of them in one call instead of N separate lookups.
    Returns `results` for found products and `not_found` for any IDs
    that don't exist in the catalog.
name: get_products_batch
